conditionJustifications.condition: Enterprise denial intersects explicit user/admin project opt-in; ordinary resolution never acquires, and workspace/env data cannot grant execution.
conditionJustifications.prevents: Untrusted project settings or a discovered path causing unintended execution/network access; plausible on first project open.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Existing discovery tests check tiers, not captured policy authorization or enterprise denial.

conditionJustifications.condition: Source visibility, selection and execution are separate; all permitted lists are explicit, deterministically ordered and epoch-bearing; forbidden adapters do zero work.
conditionJustifications.prevents: Ambient enumeration or aliases selecting a different/forbidden toolchain; existing routes already have several orders.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Current tier tests do not cover policy reorder, canonical aliases across forbidden classes or shared host identities.

conditionJustifications.condition: Verify exact origin, execution closure, integrity, compatibility, trust and revocation before any probe/execute; trust/integrity failures never become absence.
conditionJustifications.prevents: Executing a replaced/unverified binary or hiding tampering by fallback; plausible for PATH, cache and SDK candidates.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Version/protocol probing executes candidate code and cannot establish pre-execution trust.

conditionJustifications.condition: Only explicit opted-in requests reach approved HTTPS origin/package scopes; mandatory TLS, integrity, bounded redirect/extraction, no scripts or unrelated telemetry.
conditionJustifications.prevents: Unapproved download, origin substitution or archive escape; plausible with hostile metadata.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: No current managed writer exists; packaging/local discovery guards do not exercise acquisition.

conditionJustifications.condition: Offline/deny-network override opt-in; proxy/custom roots are explicit approved inputs and secrets stay runtime-only and redacted.
conditionJustifications.prevents: DNS/socket leakage offline or proxy credential disclosure; plausible if reused generic downloader defaults.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Local source tests have no downloader, proxy authentication or public redaction boundary.

conditionJustifications.condition: Policy/revocation/host changes supersede work; complete facts revalidate before reuse/publication; rollback revalidates the prior known-good receipt.
conditionJustifications.prevents: Publishing a stale provider or reusing a revoked artifact after permission changes; plausible under concurrent acquisition/activation.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Existing ProviderHub epochs do not capture the proposed provisioning policy basis.

conditionJustifications.condition: Distinct phase/state/reason/completeness and ordered provenance; Available requires selection and active handshake receipts.
conditionJustifications.prevents: An installed file, failed activation or missing provider being reported available; plausible with current coarse status adapters.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Package and discovery tests cannot establish current per-operation provider availability.

conditionJustifications.condition: Browser-local native execution is Unsupported; companions/remotes require exact host trust plus explicit execution/source-transfer permission.
conditionJustifications.prevents: Native spawn or silent source upload from a browser request; plausible if host fallback is implicit.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: Desktop engine tests cannot certify browser or remote permission boundaries.

conditionJustifications.condition: All external-engine shipping channels are closed; retain no-tsgo guards until separate exact release authorization.
conditionJustifications.prevents: Accidentally shipping engine bytes through existing sidecar support; current resolver still recognizes sidecars.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: VSIX guards cover that artifact only; other package families and runtime selection need explicit closed-channel treatment.

conditionJustifications.condition: Pure bounded snapshot policy evaluation does no I/O; disabled/ordinary resolution never installs or networks; counters separate acquisition, validation, selection and activation.
conditionJustifications.prevents: Repeated registry/provider/FS work hidden in warm resolution; plausible when acquisition is wired into discovery.
conditionJustifications.notCoveredBecause: No current cross-authority work accounting covers the new source policy.

proofBoundary: Contract data and bounded inspection only. Runtime enforcement, negative controls, fresh/warm and work proofs are mapped to receiving production owners in companion cases; not claimed executed by EPR0.

stageProducers.law: Each producer preserves phase-specific typed evidence. A successful stage reports its own state (Acquired, Resolved, Selected) and receipt with capability Unavailable; every other state except Available carries the phase that produced it. Available is activate-only, and EPR5 alone publishes active engine availability. The outcomes receiving owner names the shared projection or representative behavioral boundary, not permission for other phases to erase the state.
